name: filter-patient
description: Convenience script runner for the three independent projects. Not a workspace — api/, patient-web/ and doctor-web/ each own their dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix patient-web install && npm --prefix doctor-web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,patient,doctor -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix api run start:dev" "npm --prefix patient-web run dev" "npm --prefix doctor-web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix patient-web run build && npm --prefix doctor-web run build
scripts.test: npm run check:evaluator && npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix patient-web test
